data.exact_reserve_text: During 2020 the syndicate released prior year reserves of $75.1m (2019: $15.9m). Specialty lines and cyber & executive risk had releases of $37.5m and $7.0m respectively. Both specialty lines and cyber & executive risk have been impacted over the past few years by the increased claims seen on their liability books resulting in decreased releases. Action taken in the Marine division to remediate selected areas of the account, including the UK Marine portfolio in January 2020, have resulted in a release of $8.6m in the division. Both the property and reinsurance divisions have benefitted from releases on some of the 2019 natural catastrophe events, namely Storm Dorian in the US and Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai in Japan.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a prior year reserve release of $75.1m in 2020, driven by favourable development across specialty lines and cyber & executive risk (releases of $37.5m and $7.0m respectively), remediation actions in the Marine division (release of $8.6m) and reserve releases relating to some 2019 natural catastrophe events (notably Storm Dorian and Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai) which benefited the property and reinsurance portfolios.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development taken from narrative statement 'released prior year reserves of $75.1m' (document does not present an explicit 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column). Narrative appears to describe gross releases and divisional releases are quantified for some lines; therefore the $75.1m is treated as a gross release. Opening gross claims outstanding sourced from balance sheet 'Claims outstanding' (prior year comparative). A gross claims development triangle is present but not in a readily extractable monetary development-period layout for diagonal comparison; therefore triangle was not used to compute PYD. Field names include 'gbp_m' though amounts reported in native currency USD (per report).

_claims_triangle.notes: Gross claims development tables (gross and net) exist in the notes (pages 51-52) but the report provides development percentages and summary ultimate/paid/unearned lines rather than a clear row-by-row cumulative monetary 'At end of underwriting year / One year later / Two years later' matrix suitable for diagonal PYD calculation without further reconciliation. As such development period monetary rows are not provided here.
